notes: JBS S.A. (B3: JBSS3) — world's largest meat producer. Five business units: Beef North America, Beef South America, Seara (Brazilian processed/poultry), Pilgrim's Pride (66.4% owned NYSE: PPC), and Friboi/Australia. NYSE secondary listing JBS (JBS) effective June 2025. FY ends Dec 31. All figures BRL-mm consolidated IFRS. Receita bruta (gross revenue) = net revenue + indirect taxes (~1.5-2% in BR) where disclosed; international sales no gross-up. Net debt / leverage shown on company-defined basis (incl. lease liabilities).

periods.notes: FY20: Pandemic disruption + record beef cycle in NA. Net revenue R$270.2bn, EBITDA R$27.0bn (margin 10.0%), NI R$4.36bn.
FY21: Peak NA beef cycle. Revenue R$350.7bn (+30%), EBITDA R$44.5bn (margin 12.7%) — record year. Aggressive buyback.
FY22: Revenue R$374.9bn (+7%), EBITDA R$32.5bn (margin 8.7%) — beef cycle began rolling over in NA.
FY23: Trough year. Revenue R$363.8bn (-3%), EBITDA R$16.0bn (margin 4.4%) — NA beef margin compression + chicken weak. Net loss R$1.1bn.
FY24: Recovery. Revenue R$416.1bn (+14%), EBITDA R$30.2bn (margin 7.3%), NI R$6.77bn. Leverage 2.2x. Dividend R$2.3bn.
